acceptanceObjective: Re-certify head/face-feasible legacy MotionPlanner semantic templates (nod, head-shake, bow) through the standard four-layer pipeline with dual-model offline review and register them as production certified skills; arm-dependent templates stay blocked pending a physics-writer decision.
notes: Cloud authorization granted by product owner on 2026-09-18: DeepSeek primary + GLM secondary offline review of isolated-environment model frames, within default-operational-thresholds budget (DeepSeek <=6 CNY per batch, off-peak, hash-cached). Scope note: head/face templates use runtime-verified parameters (ParamAngleX/Y/Z, body angles); arm-based templates (wave, hands-on-hips, cover-face, point, beckon, pray, stretch) are blocked by the physics-writer override finding (Param31-37 read zero under physics mode) and require a separate decision before inclusion. Playing goes through the existing PlayCertifiedMotion curve-data path; curve JSONs stay out of the repository per license.
